steps: The default mode permits selection without edits. Dragging in view mode, toggling adjustment mode and a zero-distance pointer gesture preserve clean form/source/author bytes. Offset mode is explicit.

A real captured drag produces only a ghost under the actual inverse SVG CTM, including horizontal letterboxing and changed zoom. Escape cancels the gesture without closing the dialog. Mode changes and saved-geometry refresh cancel in-flight gestures; late pointer release changes no fields or author bytes.

An outward drag from the inclusive +8192 limit is rejected, without clamping or modifying either axis. The original numeric spelling 8.192e3 and checked review remain exact; no invalid temporary collision shape is shown.

A noncentral actual mouse grab commits the exact inverse-CTM delta on pointer release, without snapping the collider center. Only X/Y form fields change; the old preview and Apply authority disappear until Check. The resulting full-source review changes only the two offset leaves.

A cancelled form is reopened while an old HTTP geometry response is held; its late completion cannot replace new unfinished input. Actual Shift-click nudge adds 10, Shift-arrow on the stage subtracts 10, and ordinary button/arrow nudges each add 1. Arrows in a numeric input and Ctrl-arrows do not adjust offsets. Each accepted change requires Check again.

The final collider is a radius-12 circle with offset X=2 produced by button and keyboard edits. Refreshing a deliberately moved disposable saved scene updates world geometry only; the local offset, exact fields, focus, selected text and checked source review remain intact. Restoring the scene restores its geometry.

At 390px, Chinese, English and Japanese retain focused adjustment controls, exact field nodes and checked review. Direction buttons fit the viewport; circle proportions, dialog containment and fixed Check/Apply/Cancel actions remain correct.

Geometry transport failure preserves ordinary field editing and the checked review. Missing scene targets remain selectable declarations but cannot produce movement proposals; restoring the saved target restores adjustment controls. Neither readonly condition edits sources.

Apply changes only the ordinary source draft; reopening displays its checked collision geometry over saved actor positions. Cancel keeps that draft. Ordinary Save changes only the exact reviewed physics source, preserving BOM, CRLF, escaped key and untouched body text. No resource bytes are fetched.

GUI Plan, Build and real Godot headless Run consume the saved circle radius 12 and local offset X 2. Character stops at x≈131; actual sensor enter/exit publishes the other instance UUID from its sensor binding. Animation completes idle/action/idle under unchanged project protocol 10.
